Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Brightware's ingestion pipeline and the LLM features you want to add. Quick recap from our side and a suggested next step: 

Summary of findings:
- Primary use case: automated product insights (summarization + Q&A) for support docs and release notes
- Key constraint: PII redaction required for customer-facing summaries; retention policy of 30 days
- Success metrics: 95% intent accuracy on key queries, <200ms 95th percentile latency for short Q&A
- Current infra: internal Postgres + S3; plans to scale to 1M monthly queries within 6 months

Recommended next step:
- 2-week pilot targeting the support docs workflow (ingest -> embeddings -> retrieval -> generation)
- Redwood to provide a pilot config, example prompt templates, and a performance target SLA
- Proposed kickoff: week of Feb 16 (2x 30-minute sessions: kickoff + integration plan)

I've attached a short discovery recap with the call notes and proposed pilot scope (20260210-discovery-recap-Brightware.pdf).

Would you be available to confirm whether Feb 16 works, or share two windows that do? If you'd prefer, we can also do a short technical sync with your infra lead to scope the ingestion work.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing thoughts.

Best,
